author: Max760
quote:
Graphics are cool, mechanics are great, big map with alot of details, but sadly there is no GTA feeling in this one... No funny weird activities... No going a mission only to get drugged and get abducted by aliens like in GTA 5... No homie like Lamar... Just a game real life simulator where doing chores and fixing stuff is supposed to be "fun" I don't where is the fun in peeing while sitting down just because my gf told me to... I don't want to paint an entire room in game when I just did that in real life with a friend... Yeah the again I'll say the world is great... I have fun while I'm driving and honking at cars and suddenly get yelled at by a random NPC telling me to go screw myself... I am glad they went all in with the when it comes to how to get money and actually spending it because I racked millions in GTA 5 with little to no effort... But in the end I will still be bothered that I'm not hearing funny dialogue... Not seeing funny scenes like Trevor complimenting Amanda on her "nice new ****"... And not driving like a maniac on coke with Franklin... I will just have to endure the lucia telling me what to do... Deal with Jason's uncaring behaviour like he's just waiting for the day he dies in game but actually motivated to rob and kill people... Just because I paid $100.
Thanks Rockstar for 13 years of waiting... Now I know truly believe in the saying "it ain't about the destination it's about the journey" take me back to when we were looking out for leaks for GTA 6... Or bring back Dan houser.
